description: Hypothesis: skipping unchanged attention rescaling and fully-visible masks, reusing dense input conversions, using cooperative FP32 affine down stores, and prefetching FP32 DeltaNet inputs improve the 2261.1 tok/s load-first base. Four components change together; isolated controls and whole-model profiles are separate evidence. Same affine-8 group-64 v2 weights/cache, BF16 scale/bias, FP16 KV/operands, FP32 state/accumulation/outputs, K32 experts, 32x256 attention tiles, staged8 recurrence, DFlash2, 2048-token chunks and 32768-token context. Development improvement versus a later control was 3.84% at 10K and 5.58% at 30K; these are not official scores. Run all seven Full-profile tests.
